text:
elaine-docs: FYI new user reported sampleapp chat hangs. REST longpoll works but SDK returns immediately. Repro below.

omar-sdk: Paste snippets?

elaine-docs: curl: `curl -s 'https://api.redwood.ai/events?wait_for=3' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T'` -> blocks ~3s.

SDK (node): `await client.events.list({ wait_for: 3 })` -> returns instantly with []

tiago-backend: Server expects numeric query param. If SDK drops it we return immediately (no events).

omar-sdk: Investigated: our query serializer strips params if value === '' or null, and coerces some numbers to ''. Also retry middleware treats empty 200 as transient. Likely two bugs.

nora-qe: I can reproduce on python too — string '3' works, int 3 fails. We should add an e2e to sampleapp.

omar-sdk: Plan: preserve numeric/boolean params, only drop undefined/null. Also avoid retrying on 200 when content-type indicates possible empty body. Will open PR.

tiago-backend: We'll add a short server-side tolerance during rollout so onboarding doesn't break.

bot-ci: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/250 (ci: pending)

elaine-docs: Leaving a quick note in quickstart advising REST or string workaround until fix lands. Follow-up when PR merges. Cheers :thumbsup:
